contents.name: def-nonlinear-experimental-design-and-local-identifiability
contents.reason: The local definition fixes the finite real-weight design convention and nonlinear observation map. Boyd–Vandenberghe and Madsen provide full-text treatments of approximate-design conventions; the local definition states all objects and hypotheses explicitly.

contents.name: alg-finite-budget-multiplicative-d-optimal-design
contents.reason: The algorithm is a finite exact-arithmetic wrapper around the multiplicative recurrence. The full Dette–Pepelyshev–Zhigljavsky paper and Boyd–Vandenberghe give accessible design treatments; this item makes no asymptotic convergence claim.

contents.name: thm-multiplicative-design-update-well-defined-and-terminates
contents.reason: The complete local proof uses the trace identity, nonnegative updated weights, and the local information-rank criterion to preserve the simplex and nonsingularity for every finite update. It does not import a convergence theorem.

contents.name: thm-equivalence-violation-bounds-d-optimal-design-gap
contents.reason: The local proof derives the log-determinant tangent bound, computes its directional derivative, and combines it with the existing D-equivalence theorem. Boyd–Vandenberghe is a full-text comparison treatment.

contents.name: thm-uniform-sensitivity-error-controls-design-gap
contents.reason: The local proof combines the uniform log-determinant perturbation estimate with compactness and a tau-approximate maximum; Boyd–Vandenberghe and McLean et al. are full-text comparison treatments.

contents.name: ex-endpoint-sensors-give-a-d-optimal-linear-time-design
contents.reason: The local proof computes the three information matrices, sensitivities, update, and violation exactly. The D-optimality criterion is also treated in the fetched Boyd–Vandenberghe book and Dette et al. paper.

contents.name: ex-solver-tolerance-can-reverse-a-design-ranking
contents.reason: The finite scalar ranking and uniform mixture bounds are computed directly; B&V and McLean et al. supply full-text context for D-optimal information criteria and sensitivity conditioning.
